description: Give a returning agent a bounded accountless context bundle with optional cursor-aware Bazaar delta/trending results, statuses, next cursor, and evidence hash. $0.005/call via x402.

components.description: Optional signals to include; defaults to the four legacy components.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned by a prior poll.

since_snapshot.description: Completed Bazaar snapshot date to anchor a delta/trending poll.

name: agent_return_context
